summary: estimate_training_memory.py printed 'Does not fit' but exited 0 (and its --json output had no status), so a script or workflow that read the exit code took a configuration that does not fit in GPU memory as one that fits.

impact.bias: the verdict carried by the exit code was 'fits' for every valid input; the printed text and the memory numbers were right
impact.trigger: a configuration whose estimated per-GPU memory exceeds the stated capacity, when the caller reads the exit code or the JSON instead of the text

outputs.how_to_recognize: a text report, or JSON with --json (per_gpu_bytes, per_gpu_gb, fits); its exit code carried the verdict

remedy: rerun estimate_training_memory.py on a release that has the fix (or read its text verdict) for any configuration accepted on the exit code alone; the memory numbers themselves did not change
